title: A World People Stayed In
summary: A living digital place shaped through worldbuilding, systems, content, and community.
body:
This is sample project copy, ready to replace in the CMS. Tell the story behind the work: what you were trying to make, who it was for, and why the idea mattered.

## The approach

Walk through your role and the decisions that made the project special. Add the details only you would know—the constraints, experiments, collaborators, and discoveries along the way.

## The outcome

Close with what changed. That might be a number, a response from the community, a lesson you carried forward, or simply the fact that the thing now exists in the world.
